message.content: Evaluate originality in empirical robustness studies by prioritizing novel problem formulations (e.g., geometric equivariance vs. pixel-wise robustness trade-offs) and critical insights that challenge existing assumptions. Assess the logical motivation behind combining existing techniques and the value of negative results. Penalize limited experimental scope (e.g., MNIST-only) that undermines the generalizability of the findings.
